payload.answer: Add `vibey abandon <project_id>`: transition a project to the ABANDONED phase, releasing its repo_path so a new project can be created against that repository. This is not hypothetical -- it is currently blocking real work. The project table has a `project_repo_uniq` constraint (one project per repo_path), and a stale project (expansion-13-cost-performance, stuck in BUILD since 2026-08-20, whose work actually shipped as PR #70) permanently holds [path] `vibey new --repo [path]` fails with UniqueViolationError and there is no supported way to release it. The only current escape is hand-editing the database, which is exactly what a CLI should prevent. ABANDONED is already a legal value in the Phase enum, so this finishes an existing concept rather than inventing one.
